Part.name: Duplet - modular 1x1 panel (slim 26 mm)
Part.description: Duplet - modular hull panel (game proxy) Starts at one surface cell; resize X/Z to add whole cells (1x1, 1x2, 2x1, 2x2 ... 8x8). Each cell has its own visible cover and finite reactive charge. Two physically separate paid depth stages; depth is locked. Base cell: 125 x 250 x 26 mm; two 10 mm active slabs (authoring estimate, not factory data) Plates: 2 | Layers: 2 Effective angles: 30-70 deg (best APFSDS) Kinetic (APFSDS) at 60 deg: 30% less pen. Chemical (HEAT) at 60 deg: 70% less pen. Tandem: each reached layer spends its own exact cell; no proximity ownership Mass and cost scale with paid cell area only, never depth
